There's been some speculation that certain artwork from The Dark may have
originally been intended for Jyhad.  Top candidates:  Blood of the Martyr

Is this true?  A couple of beer-bets have been made...

>(crying blood--obviously a World of Darkness Vampire), and Elves of Deep
>Shadows (*very* Gothic-Punk).
>Is this true?  A couple of beer-bets have been made...

The Dark was conceived from the start as having a very goth/punk mood
to it.  Blood of the Martyr would actually make a bad vampire card, since
it's not a portrait.  In any case, I'm sure all the art for The Dark
was made for The Dark, and isn't just Jyhad rejects.
